description.en:
H2 Plus is Unitree's humanoid development configuration combining a full-size body with substantial onboard computation and tactile dexterous hands. The manufacturer's presentation includes NVIDIA Jetson Thor computing, stereo head vision, wrist cameras and an inertial sensor for perception and policy execution.

The platform connects teleoperation and demonstration capture with model development through NVIDIA Isaac GR00T and related tools. Its specification distinguishes a rated arm payload of 7 kg from a higher peak figure, while battery endurance depends on activity. H2 Plus is positioned as a system for developing dexterous manipulation and whole-body behaviors, with task performance determined by the deployed model and operating conditions.
